newsitem.title: USA: Rexrodt--dlr/mark volatility if EMU doubts rise.
newsitem.headline: Rexrodt--dlr/mark volatility if EMU doubts rise.

text.p: Germany's Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said he expects volatility in dollar/mark if doubts of European Monetary Union continued to grow.

Speaking at a conference sponsored by The European Institute on Financial and Monetary Affairs, Rexrodt said the value of the single European currency "will be relatively strong as long as the (European) governments stick to the criteria" of the Maastricht treaty.
Rexrodt also said "if there were more doubts" about the interpretation and implementation of the Maastricht criteria, "we will lose the value of the currency."

Rexrodt emphasized that the mark "gets stronger if there are more doubts in the timetable of the Eureaopn currency, and the deutschemark declines if there is no doubt about the time schedule and the criteria."
Commenting on the current mark level, Rexrodt said the price relative to the dollar "is sound and based on fundamentals, and that's the right way."
